items.source: locale - the locale in which to do the lookup
items.translation: locale - 执行查找的本地化环境

items.source: code - the code to lookup up, such as 'calculator.noRateSet'
items.translation: code - 要查找的代码，例如 'calculator.noRateSet'

items.source: args - array of arguments that will be filled in for params within the message
items.translation: args - 用于填充消息中参数的参数数组

items.source: the resolved message, or null if not found
items.translation: 已解析的消息，或如果未找到则为null

items.source: Subclasses must implement the abstract resolveCode(String, Locale) method. For efficient resolution of messages without arguments, the resolveCodeWithoutArguments(String, Locale) method should be overridden as well, resolving messages without a MessageFormat being involved.
items.translation: 子类必须实现抽象的 resolveCode(String, Locale) 方法。为了高效地解析不带参数的消息，还应重写 resolveCodeWithoutArguments(String, Locale) 方法，以在不涉及 MessageFormat 的情况下解析消息。

items.source: The default implementation does use MessageFormat, through delegating to the resolveCode(String, Locale) method. Subclasses are encouraged to replace this with optimized resolution.
items.translation: 默认实现确实使用 MessageFormat，通过委托给resolveCode(String, Locale)方法。鼓励子类用优化的解析方式替换此实现。

items.source: Subclasses are encouraged to provide optimized resolution for messages without arguments, not involving MessageFormat. See the resolveCodeWithoutArguments(String, Locale) javadoc for details.
items.translation: 鼓励子类为不涉及 MessageFormat 的无参数消息提供优化的解析。有关详细信息，请参阅 resolveCodeWithoutArguments(String, Locale) 的 Javadoc。

items.source: May also link to an externally defined Properties object, for example, defined through a PropertiesFactoryBean.
items.translation: 也可以链接到外部定义的 Properties 对象，例如通过PropertiesFactoryBean定义的对象。

items.source: Note: In case of a MessageSourceResolvable with multiple codes (like a FieldError) and a MessageSource that has a parent MessageSource, do not activate "useCodeAsDefaultMessage" in the parent: Else, you'll get the first code returned as message by the parent, without attempts to check further codes.
items.translation: 注意：对于具有多个代码的 MessageSourceResolvable（例如 FieldError）以及具有父 MessageSource 的 MessageSource，请勿在父 MessageSource 中激活"useCodeAsDefaultMessage"；否则，您将获得由父 MessageSource 返回的第一个代码作为消息，而不会尝试检查其他代码。

items.source: To be able to work with "useCodeAsDefaultMessage" turned on in the parent, AbstractMessageSource and AbstractApplicationContext contain special checks to delegate to the internal getMessageInternal(String, Object[], Locale) method if available. In general, it is recommended to just use "useCodeAsDefaultMessage" during development and not rely on it in production in the first place, though.
items.translation: 要在父级中启用"useCodeAsDefaultMessage"，AbstractMessageSource 和 AbstractApplicationContext 包含特殊检查，如果可用则委托到内部getMessageInternal(String, Object[], Locale)方法。不过，通常建议在开发期间仅使用"useCodeAsDefaultMessage"，而不应在生产环境中依赖它。

items.source: Alternatively, consider overriding the getDefaultMessage(MessageSourceResolvable, Locale) method to return a custom fallback message for an unresolvable code.
items.translation: 或者，考虑重写getDefaultMessage(MessageSourceResolvable, Locale)方法，以返回不可解析代码的自定义后备消息。

items.source: Default is to return the code itself if "useCodeAsDefaultMessage" is activated, or return no fallback else. In case of no fallback, the caller will usually receive a NoSuchMessageException from getMessage.
items.translation: 默认情况下，如果激活了"useCodeAsDefaultMessage"，则返回代码本身；否则不返回任何回退值。如果没有回退值，调用方通常会从`getMessage` 收到一个 `NoSuchMessageException`。

items.source: Note: By default, message texts are only parsed through MessageFormat if arguments have been passed in for the message. In case of no arguments, message texts will be returned as-is. As a consequence, you should only use MessageFormat escaping for messages with actual arguments, and keep all other messages unescaped. If you prefer to escape all messages, set the "alwaysUseMessageFormat" flag to "true".
items.translation: 注意： 默认情况下，仅当消息已传入参数时，消息文本才会通过 MessageFormat 进行解析。如果没有参数，消息文本将原样返回。因此，您应只为包含实际参数的消息使用 MessageFormat 转义，而保持其他所有消息未转义。如果您希望转义所有消息，请将 "alwaysUseMessageFormat" 标志设置为 "true"。

items.source: This implementation fully renders the default message if available, or just returns the plain default message String if the primary message code is being used as a default message.
items.translation: 此实现会完整渲染默认消息（如果可用），或者当主消息代码被用作默认消息时，仅返回纯文本的默认消息 `String`。

items.source: Unfortunately, java.text.MessageFormat is not implemented in an efficient fashion. In particular, it does not detect that a message pattern doesn't contain argument placeholders in the first place. Therefore, it is advisable to circumvent MessageFormat for messages without arguments.
items.translation: 不幸的是，`java.text.MessageFormat` 的实现效率不高。特别是，它无法检测消息模式本身是否包含参数占位符。因此，建议对于不含参数的消息，避免使用 MessageFormat。

items.source:
Supports not only MessageSourceResolvables as primary messages
but also resolution of message arguments that are in turn
MessageSourceResolvables themselves.
items.translation: 不仅支持将 MessageSourceResolvables 作为主要消息，还支持解析本身为 MessageSourceResolvables 的消息参数。

items.source:
This class does not implement caching of messages per code, thus
subclasses can dynamically change messages over time. Subclasses are
encouraged to cache their messages in a modification-aware fashion,
allowing for hot deployment of updated messages.
items.translation: 该类未实现按代码缓存消息，因此子类可以随时间动态更改消息。鼓励子类以感知修改的方式缓存其消息，从而支持更新消息的热部署。

items.source: Allows for messages to have MessageSourceResolvables as arguments.
items.translation: 允许消息具有 MessageSourceResolvables 作为参数。

items.source:
Returns a MessageFormat instance rather than a message String,
to allow for appropriate caching of MessageFormats in subclasses.
items.translation: 返回一个 MessageFormat 实例而不是消息字符串，以便在子类中适当缓存 MessageFormat。
